Requirement (short): Acquisition, cataloguing, serials, circulation, OPAC, barcode and spine-label, reports

Notes: Acquisition, serials and spine-label printing are not built. Existing ILMS is assumed to own them; see docs/06_LIMITATIONS_AND_BACKLOG.md

Requirement (short): Web UI, full-text search, real-time indexing, net cataloguing, virtual bookshelf
Implementation: app/static/*; SQLite FTS5 index kept current by triggers (schema v2); /opac/search; /catalog/search
Notes: Net cataloguing and virtual bookshelf not built

Requirement (short): Staff station, handheld, gate, smart card, tags via middleware; NCIP 2.0 and SIP2 boundary
Implementation: app/rfid/*; app/adapters/ncip.py; app/adapters/sip2.py; python -m app.cli sip2
Notes: Message subsets only. No conformance or certification claimed

Requirement (short): Check-out, check-in, renewal, due date, reference restriction, member blocking, fine limits, role rights
Implementation: app/services/circulation.py; policy in app/config.py (env overridable); role checks in app/security.py
Notes: Patron-card personalisation (printing) not built; card UID is stored per member

Requirement (short): Validate title or member before tagging, link tag to record, tag monitoring
Implementation: app/rfid/service.py::tag_item; RfidTag with partial unique index; audit entries
Notes: Tag monitoring = tag status, history and audit trail

Requirement (short): Stock verification, misplaced and missing items, bulk read, audible or visible confirmation
Implementation: app/rfid/service.py inventory; handheld mock beeps; UI toast plus browser beep
Notes: Audible cue in the browser is a Web Audio beep

Requirement (short): Unauthorised removal, security bit, accession number, alarm, footfall, CCTV photo, email
Notes: Gate reads local data so it works while the ILMS is offline

Requirement (short): Usage statistics for tagged items, members, circulation, operators, RFID clients, fines, gate events
Notes: Date and location filters

Requirement (short): Configurable email, SMS, print per user through provider-neutral adapters
Implementation: app/services/notifications.py; per-member channel; retry and permanent failure
Notes: Mock providers only

Requirement (short): ~20,000 spreadsheet records: validation, duplicates, error logs, reconciliation, rollback
Notes: 20,100 synthetic rows in about 1 second

Requirement (short): Users and roles, configuration, audit logs, version reporting, health info
Notes: Roles are a fixed matrix. Role editing UI not built

Requirement (short): Offline activation, updates, upgrades, patches; installable package with rollback instructions
Notes: Verified with the network unreachable

Requirement (short): Back up before integration; never modify, delete or corrupt existing records
Implementation: Automatic backup before every real import and every update; import only adds rows and can be rolled back by batch id
Notes: Integration with the ILMS is read-only by design

Requirement (short): Least privilege, secrets, audit, input validation, encrypted transport
Implementation: app/security.py; per-install JWT secret; masked audit; defusedxml; parameterised SQL
Notes: TLS is expected from a reverse proxy; not terminated by the app. See limitations

Requirement (short): Windows 11 clients, Windows Server 2022+, Ethernet, isolated site
Implementation: Pure-Python app; --windows flag in package builder; browser UI
Notes: Windows package built but not run on Windows in this evaluation
